reviewer_reason:
Reader A separates the distinct lactate-inhibitor and siMicu1-LNP interventions, but both readers overassign experimental context. A custom six-experiment map is required, with unresolved model context for interventions not explicitly assigned to in-vivo or in-vitro settings.

Use this custom map:
ACT in-vivo HIRI experimentScope: S03–S06
Model: HIRI mice
Treatment: ACT

ACT in-vitro LSEC experimentScope: S03–S06
Model: hypoxia-reoxygenation or lactate-stimulated LSECs
Treatment: ACT

LSEC-specific Micu1-overexpression experimentScope: S03 and S07
Intervention: Micu1-overexpression virus
Model context: leave unresolved from the abstract

ACT plus siMicu1-LNP experimentScope: S03 and S07
Intervention: ACT + siMicu1 LNP
Model context: unresolved unless full text establishes it

ACT plus lactate-inhibitor experimentScope: S07
Intervention: ACT + lactate inhibitor
Model context: unresolved

ACT-derivative structural-analysis experimentScope: S03 and S08
Intervention: ACT derivatives
This is not an LNP experiment, but keeping it as a separate neighboring experiment prevents its structural results from leaking into the siMicu1-LNP record.
